title: Channel declaration
description: An entry in world-manifest.observation_channels or world-manifest.command_channels (AWP-DAT-002, AWP-CMD-001).

id.description: Unique per world. awp.* names are reserved (awp.tf).

modality.description: From the modality registry or x-<vendor>.<name> (AWP-MOD-002).

rate_hz.description: Nominal push rate; null for per-tick lockstep channels.

keyframe_interval.description: Frames between keyframes when deltas are used (AWP-OBS-004).

stale_after_ms.description: Age after which frames are stale; drives channel_degraded on reliable channels (AWP-SAF-009). Default 2 × period.

schema.description: Modality-specific parameters (dimensions, sample rates, event schema).
